central.name: PM E-DRIVE
central.lastChangeNote: MHI notification extended electric two-wheeler demand incentives from 31 July 2026 to 31 March 2028 and raised the two-wheeler allocation to ₹2,767 crore. Rate and cap unchanged.

sources.title: PM E-DRIVE portal, Ministry of Heavy Industries
Autocar India: PM E-Drive subsidy for electric two-wheelers extended to March 2028 (12 Aug 2026)
DriveSpark: PM E-Drive subsidy for electric two-wheelers extended till FY28 (13 Aug 2026)

onRoadModel.note: On-road estimate = ex-showroom + road tax (state rule) + registration (EVs exempt nationwide since MoRTH 2021) + insurance estimate + HSRP and handling.

cash.text: ₹10,000/kWh capped at ₹30,000 in year one, plus ₹10,000 for scrapping a BS-IV or older two-wheeler. Price cap ₹2.25 lakh ex-showroom.
cash.paidHow: Apply within 30 days of RC; paid by bank transfer within 60 days

assam.name: Assam

cash.text: The EV Policy 2021 paid ₹10,000/kWh up to ₹20,000 on scooters under ₹1.5 lakh ex-factory. Its five-year term ended around 4 September 2026 and no extension or successor policy had been notified as of 17 October 2026.

assam.notes: Treat as no state subsidy until a new notification appears.

sources.title: Assam Electric Vehicle Policy 2021 (Industries & Commerce Dept)

maharashtra.name: Maharashtra
maharashtra.notes: Policy runs 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2030. Full road tax and registration waiver.

cash.text: ₹10,000, or ₹12,000 for SC/ST buyers, for purchases from 15 May 2026 through the DBT portal.
₹5,000 to ₹10,000 by battery size slab, plus SGST reimbursement. Disbursement has been slow.

odisha.name: Odisha
odisha.notes: The Commerce and Transport Department extended the Odisha EV Policy 2021 to 31 December 2026 (reported 5 October 2026). This is the third extension, after 31 March and 30 September 2026.

sources.title: The Hans India: Odisha extends EV policy validity till Dec 31 (5 Oct 2026)

cash.text: 5% of price, plus 10% more with a scrapping certificate. Ex-showroom must be under ₹1 lakh.

tamil-nadu.name: Tamil Nadu
tamil-nadu.notes: Road tax exemption extended to 31 December 2027.

karnataka.name: Karnataka
karnataka.notes: The 2026 move to slab road tax on EVs covers cars. Electric two-wheelers stay exempt.

sources.title: EV Auto India: state-wise EV incentives 2026 (updated 7 Oct 2026)

telangana.name: Telangana
telangana.notes: 100% road tax and registration waiver until 31 December 2026. No extension notified as of 17 October 2026.

sources.title: ETV Bharat: Incentives fuel transition to EVs in Telangana (19 Aug 2026)

haryana.name: Haryana
haryana.notes: Exemption broadened by Cabinet on 29 July 2026 to all EVs up to ₹30 lakh.

uttar-pradesh.name: Uttar Pradesh
uttar-pradesh.notes: Road tax exemption reinstated to 13 October 2027.

gujarat.name: Gujarat

cash.text: No cash subsidy. The 2021 policy expired and the subsidy was removed from the e-VEG portal.

gujarat.notes: The 1% concessional tax ran to 31 March 2026. No successor notification found as of 17 October 2026. Ask the RTO or dealer.

west-bengal.name: West Bengal
west-bengal.notes: Last confirmed road tax exemption ran to 31 March 2025. No successor policy notified.

cash.text: Uncertain. Policy validity is disputed and may have lapsed in February 2026.
Uncertain. February 2026 reporting suggests cash incentives may not be paid for the rest of the policy period.

uttarakhand.name: Uttarakhand
uttarakhand.notes: The 2026 policy is still a draft awaiting cabinet approval.

items: Odisha: EV Policy 2021 extended to 31 December 2026 by the Commerce and Transport Department (reported 5 October 2026). The ₹5,000 state subsidy continues.
Assam: the EV Policy 2021 term ended around 4 September 2026. No extension or new policy notified as of 17 October 2026, so we now list no Assam state subsidy.
PM E-DRIVE: no change since the 12 August 2026 extension to 31 March 2028. ₹2,500/kWh, capped at ₹5,000.
Telangana: road tax waiver still ends 31 December 2026. No extension notified yet.
Full rewrite against the 10 August 2026 PM E-DRIVE amendment and state-by-state verification.
